_doc: S3 source-grounded pack for France (FR), generated by generate_world_packs.py (seed namespace 's3-world-v1', deterministic) from the worldwidelaw/legal-sources sample snapshot via world-law-catalog.json. 6 True items quote title/date/source/identifier VERBATIM from real collected documents; 6 False items are controlled mutations of those same documents (date-shift, wrong-source cross-jurisdiction trap, identifier near-miss). Bibliographic claims only, no legal doctrine, which is the anti-hallucination contract: every True fact exists in the repo, every False item is false by construction and its rationale states the mutation plus the true fact. tier is the single value 'source' (dates here are claim content, not recency probes, so the date-tier convention of nl-ecli-tiered.json does not apply). 50/50 True/False balance prevents 'always answer X' gaming. See packs/world/README.md.
